causalChain: RESOURCE and much of MATERIALS begin with an internal value-product problem: contribution value per worker is below wage at current price/productivity scales

researchTimeline.result: Long-run collapse reproduced under controlled baseline.
Labor matching, voluntary consumption cuts, and single-factor credit explanations narrowed or rejected as primary roots.
Exit propagation identified as a major late-stage unemployment amplifier; generic root search closed.
Entrant credit timing and startup-finance defects confirmed, but aggregate employment impact remained secondary.
Estate stranding and accounting representation defects confirmed; tax-feedback root hypothesis falsified.
Restructure-vs-liquidate architecture shown economically material; supply relief becomes a complement after restructuring.
Detached former-worker claims are secondary; current-worker payroll under-coverage and repeated restructuring are dominant.
Production-linked staffing restores employment/output but explodes arrears; hard hybrid removes arrears by collapsing employment/output.
Two sector mechanisms separated: upstream plan-economics shortfall versus downstream realization failure.
12/12 economic shards confirm RESOURCE value product/wage only 0.526–0.602 with 100% of rows below wage; worker indivisibility falsified as the RESOURCE root.
11/12 shards show CONSUMER and CAPITAL realization loss occurs mainly at production execution; CONSUMER finished-goods absorption is comparatively strong.
Production-execution decomposition launched; downstream B2B/investment absorption audit committed and awaiting runner pickup.
